title: DOST-PAGASA Climate Advisory for Very Strong El Niño
advisory_status: Strong El Niño active in the Tropical Pacific
outlook: Expected to intensify into a Very Strong El Niño between the September-December 2026 season and persist through the first half of 2027.
risks_mentioned: Prolonged rainfall deficits and agricultural dry spells
Food security, energy production, public health, and economic impacts
important_qualification: Habagat and active tropical cyclones may still cause localized above-normal rainfall, particularly in western areas.
use_in_product: Show as an official national advisory with issue date and link. Do not translate this national outlook into an unvalidated municipal forecast.
